metadata.title: Close/block Slack reasons always show 'no reason given' (data-shape mismatch)
metadata.description: Symptom: Slack close/block notifications always read 'Reason: no reason given' even when a reason was provided. Repro: PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK set; pm close <id> --reason 'x' (or pm update <id> --status blocked --blocked-reason 'y'); inspect built message. Observed: 'Reason: no reason given'. Expected: 'Reason: x' / 'Reason: y'. Root cause: hook read camelCase item.closedReason/blockedReason but pm emits snake_case close_reason/blocked_reason. Fix: PmItem now includes close_reason/blocked_reason; buildCloseMessage/buildBlockMessage prefer snake_case then fall back to camelCase. Proven via runtime probe: CLOSE now shows real reason, BLOCK shows real reason, minimal item still null-safe.
metadata.author: codex
metadata.close_reason: Fixed: read snake_case close_reason/blocked_reason (with camelCase fallback); verified via runtime probe with real result shapes.

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.

metadata.title: Routing model: PM_SLACK_ROUTES JSON map + per-event channel override
metadata.description: Routing is an optional JSON env PM_SLACK_ROUTES mapping a selector (event name like 'block', or type like 'type:Bug', or 'status:blocked') to {webhook?,channel?}. First matching rule wins; falls back to PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK/PM_SLACK_CHANNEL. Keeps zero-config default identical. Pure function selectRoute() unit-tested.

metadata.close_reason: Implemented as designed: PM_SLACK_ROUTES JSON array, first-match-wins, selector forms event/type:/status:/wildcard, fallback to PM_SLACK_WEBHOOK/CHANNEL. Zero-config default unchanged.
